items.title: Banks Want More: Trade Groups Demand Stricter Stablecoin Limits in Clarity Act
items.summary: Eight trade associations say exceptions for interest-like rewards could pull deposits from banks and reduce lending.

items.title: Where the Clarity Act stands ahead of Tuesday’s Senate vote
items.summary: The Senate heads into a consequential vote Tuesday on sweeping cryptocurrency legislation, but does it have enough support to pass?

items.title: Robinhood plans share redemptions, voting rights for stock tokens, after criticism
items.summary: CEO Vlad Tenev said more shareholder features are coming as Robinhood’s offshore stock tokens draw scrutiny over ownership rights.

items.title: Kraken brings DeFi yield to tokenized stocks and ETFs
items.summary: Kraken’s new xStocks vaults let investors earn yield on tokenized versions of Nvidia and major US stock market ETFs by lending the assets in DeFi markets.
